answer: Re-attestations are stored in nebula and ferrous lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the tide graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 815 impostors cost 1175 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
